title: Production target with a UI nobody has seen -> escalate, do not explore
context: Field trial 3. On a production URL with ui_known <= 0.25, every method is forbidden: A and D by the production rule, B by the unknown-UI rule, C and E because nothing exists.
observed_failure: An explicit environment field was silently ignored before 0.11.0 (only environmentIsProduction existed), so this input returned hybrid and the agent would have explored production.
reasoning_notes: Escalation is the right answer: the agent should read the source to raise ui_known, or ask the user to authorise exploration. It must not pick a forbidden method.
